done_when: Bridge detects a dropped generation. A timeout of <60s posts an error or resumes, rather than hanging on 'waiting for DSA' indefinitely.
need: When the DeepSeek model's generation cuts off mid-response (e.g., during the Thinking block, before emitting final text), the AIBridge status card hangs indefinitely on 'waiting for DSA after [result_id]'. The bridge should have a timeout or detect that the model stopped generating without a final message, post an error or wake-up prompt, and not sit in a stuck state requiring manual operator intervention.
title: AIBridge hangs indefinitely at 'waiting for DSA' if model generation drops mid-reply
